release_notes: **Kite weekly Oct/Nov/Dec option symbols had no live quote and couldn't be traded**: this codebase's internal option-symbol convention uses a decimal weekly month, which matches Kite's real tradingsymbol format for Jan-Sep but not Oct/Nov/Dec, where NSE/Kite encode the month as a single letter (O/N/D) instead of two digits. Breeze and Dhan already translate this internal string into their own native identifiers; Kite sent it straight through as a literal tradingsymbol, so `ltp()`/`place_order()` silently found nothing for a real, liquid, essentially-ATM weekly leg the first time one needed an Oct/Nov/Dec expiry. Added symbol translation at every boundary where a symbol crosses into/out of the Kite SDK (`ltp`, `quote`, `place_order`, `convert_to_limit`, `_marketable_limit_price`, `basket_margin`, `order_charges`, `positions`, `holdings`). **Dhan MARKET orders rejected at the HTTP layer never retried as LIMIT**: Dhan can reject a MARKET order outright ("DH-906: Invalid Price") on a thin/deep-ITM contract instead of the 200-with-`orderStatus=REJECTED` shape `place_order()` already retried as LIMIT for. That shape now retries too. Also adds "no last trade price" (Kite's own wording for the same signal) to the broker-agnostic untradeable-reason markers.
